candidates.title: Alleged Tumbler Ridge shooting co-conspirator asks court to revoke detention order
candidates.description: According to court filings, Melody Bryant was not the only one who initially failed to recognize killer Jesse Van Rootselaar was "genuinely dangerous." The motion says records show the shooter shared her plans widely and had even "received encouragement from other online contacts."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Girl, 14, planned random killing of child at her former Winnipeg elementary school: Crown
candidates.description: A teen girl accused of planning to kill a child at her former Winnipeg elementary school was radicalized online and had a romantic fantasy about an American school shooter, a court heard before the teen was granted bail last week.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Court holds N.L. man over fear he will commit terrorist acts after threats against mosque
candidates.description: Facing eight charges and a court application used when there is a “fear of terrorism offence,” Matthew Collins was allegedly making threats against a mosque.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: London, Ont., police solve 1968 murder of teenager Jackie Dunleavy using genetic genealogy
candidates.description: London, Ont., police have solved a cold case involving the murder of teenager Jackie Dunleavy, who was found strangled in 1968 after a work shift at a convenience store.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Legislation would enable Alberta to create a Crown corporation for natural gas transmission
candidates.description: The Natural Gas Infrastructure Act, if passed, would also allow the government to create a separate provincial entity to plan natural gas infrastructure in the province.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Windsor, Ont., hospital ex-employee facing 3 more sex assault charges after patients come forward: police
candidates.description: Windsor, Ont., police say new sexual assault charges have been brought against 29-year-old Cody Tyler Desbien, a former hospital ultrasound technician, bringing the count to four after more patients came forward.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Dentist pleads guilty to professional misconduct in 23-year-old's death
candidates.description: A Manitoba dentist was found guilty of professional misconduct Monday in connection with a woman's 2024 death, admitting he gave Virginia Blatz much more local anesthetic than the recommended dose.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 2 Americans sentenced to life in prison for murder of Quebec couple in Dominica
candidates.description: The two Americans convicted of murdering Quebec entrepreneur Daniel Langlois and his partner Dominique Marchand in Dominica in December 2023 were sentenced on Monday to life in prison without parole.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Defence Department tops up cadet program after outrage over cancelled activities
candidates.description: The Defence Department will top up the budget of the cadet and junior ranger programs to allow weekend training and other activities to continue into the new year, Defence Minister David McGuinty said on Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ontario, Alberta premiers weigh in on interprovincial trade, say it remains complicated
candidates.description: During a fireside chat held by the Toronto Region Board of Trade, the leaders of Ontario and Alberta said internal trade barriers remain across the country despite moves to open up interprovincial free trade.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Quebec rallies behind Montreal’s bid for global defence bank headquarters
candidates.description: Montreal is competing to host the headquarters of the Defence, Security and Resilience Bank (DSRB), and Quebec's sovereignist government has thrown its full support behind the bid.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 3 Calgary police officers charged with manslaughter in death of unarmed Blood Tribe man
candidates.description: Three Calgary police officers have been charged with manslaughter two years after an unarmed Blood Tribe man died while in police custody.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Arriving at Son of a Critch finale 'surreal', says Benjamin Evan Ainsworth
candidates.description: He's played a young Mark Critch for the last five seasons on CBC's Son of a Critch. And on Tuesday, Benjamin Evan Ainsworth will tune into the show's finale. Ahead of the finale episode, Ainsworth shared his thoughts and memories of working on the show in Newfoundland and Labrador with the CBC's Jen White.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Tighter funding leaves northern cadets out in the cold
candidates.description: The federal government is investing heavily in the North, but some people involved with the cadet program say Department of National Defence is shortchanging northern kids.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Quebec's legislative session in limbo as court mandates oath to the King
candidates.description: A Quebec Superior Court judge has suspended the province’s law that made the oath to King Charles optional, ordering that members of the province's legislature must swear allegiance before sitting at the National Assembly. Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon said Monday he would refuse to take the oath, and that he would fight the ruling.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Man charged in Edmonton-area corn maze killing found not criminally responsible
candidates.description: A man charged with second-degree murder for a fatal stabbing at an Edmonton-area corn maze has been found not criminally responsible because of a mental disorder.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Brianne Jenner named Hamilton Havoc's first-ever captain
candidates.description: Forward Brianne Jenner has been named the first captain in Hamilton Havoc history, the PWHL team said Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How will Mark Carney's appeal influence the Yorkton-Melville byelection?
candidates.description: The Liberals are running Aaron Kienle, the sitting Mayor of Yorkton, as their candidate in the byelection set for Dec. 7.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Rights group details 'surge' in violent attacks on Palestinian health-care workers
candidates.description: Based on testimony from health-care workers, Physicians for Human Rights Israel says there’s been a 350 per cent increase in violence against Palestinian health workers by settlers and the Israeli military. Israel denies the report's claims.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump administration blacklists Megaspeed cloud company linked to Nvidia scandal
candidates.description: The U.S. Commerce Department on Monday added Singapore-based Megaspeed, the cloud company at the centre of the Nvidia scandal, to its trade blacklist following criticism from lawmakers and administration officials.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: What happened at the Seattle airport? Outrage as ICE arrests man and daughter boarding flight
candidates.description: A chaotic scene unfolded at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport Saturday as a father and daughter were detained by masked immigration officers while boarding their flight bound for L.A.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. army can detonate Iowa's degraded bomb-making material, federal appeals court says
candidates.description: A federal appeals court has cleared the way for the U.S. army to detonate several tonnes of degraded bomb-making material at an Iowa ammunition plant, finding that the plan should limit the dispersal of lead dust into the atmosphere and address concerns raised by environmental groups.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'I'm not a hero,' says Arizona man who found lost toddler alone in the desert
candidates.description: Search parties with helicopters, K-9 units and heat-seeking drones scoured the rural dessert community of Eloy, Ariz. for hours looking two-year-old Vella Campillo after she wandered away from her backyard — all to no avail. Then Jay Stewart found her hiding in a bush.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Iranian singer subjected to 74 lashes for performing without her hijab
candidates.description: An Iranian singer and four members of her production team have each received 74 lashes after being sentenced for "offending public decency ‌by producing and publishing obscene and immoral content online," an Iranian news website said on Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Why Nvidia couldn't afford to lose Jensen Huang | About That
candidates.description: Nvidia's board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, stating the decision followed consultation with multiple stakeholders — including the U.S. government. Andrew Chang breaks down how the CEO of a trillion-dollar tech company returned just 11 days after being forced to step down following reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. (Photo credits: The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images)
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Pentagon takes fresh aim at Canada's military readiness, defence spending priorities
candidates.description: The Pentagon has escalated its criticism of Canada, accusing Ottawa of failing to meet NATO and NORAD obligations and putting domestic economic interests ahead of military effectiveness. The extraordinary public rebuke comes amid mounting tensions over bilateral defence co-operation, military readiness and the Carney government’s review of the F-35 purchase.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Zelenskyy confirms Ukraine was behind attack on Russian warship off Libya
candidates.description: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a naval base in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Monday, claiming that sea drones sank the vessel in a surprise assault the previous day.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How Ukraine destroyed one of Russia's newest warships
candidates.description: Ukraine says its naval drones sank one of Russia's newest vessels – the corvette Merkury – in a Libyan port. Seven drones were used in the attack, which also hit a cargo ship which President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia used to transport weapons. CBC's Briar Stewart explains what we know about the operation.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Jennifer Lopez says being Latina limited her early acting roles. Not everyone agrees
candidates.description: Jennifer Lopez said being Latina limited her early acting opportunities, prompting her to create roles for herself — a claim that drew online criticism because of her high profile and extensive career.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: You Can See Everything crosses $100M US worldwide at the box office
candidates.description: As Nathan Fielder's You Can See Everything makes its way into cinemas around the globe, the buzzy documentary is proving a big-screen draw with international audiences, too, taking in more than $100 million US at box offices worldwide.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Inside India's bold plan to transform its largest slum, Dharavi, into a multibillion-dollar development
candidates.description: India's largest slum is being cleared to make room for a modern urban development to include rehabilitated slum housing plus luxury condos and office towers. It's a massive regeneration project, funded by private and public money. But will it work?
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: FIFA picks American-led bid as 2031 Women's World Cup host
candidates.description: FIFA on Monday confirmed the United States will lead a four-nation, regional co-hosting of the 2031 Women's World Cup, and a UK project led by England was ratified for the 2035 edition.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
candidates.description: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as its president and CEO on Monday in a surprise move shortly after rejecting his offer to return. It's the latest twist in the fallout from Huang's admission of an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: COP31 climate talks collapse after member states reject deal for not mentioning fossil fuels
candidates.description: Climate talks collapsed on Sunday at COP31 in Turkey, ending the longest ever United Nations climate summit with no deal to show for it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Why the U.S. midterms might have ended JD Vance's presidential hopes
candidates.description: Vice-President JD Vance's presidential ambitions for 2028 could be among the more significant political casualties of the Democratic blue wave in this month's midterm elections.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: UN-affiliated athlete swims in dangerous Strait of Hormuz to highlight Iran war's impact on wildlife
candidates.description: Lewis Pugh, who is a United Nations Patron of the Oceans, spent three days last week swimming parts of the dangerous waterway to highlight how Iran war threatens the area's habitat and wildlife.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump calling Putin a friend is 'appalling,' says former ambassador to NATO
candidates.description: Kurt Volker, former U.S. Ambassador to NATO, tells CBC's Rosemary Barton that it’s 'appalling' to hear U.S. President Donald Trump double down on calling Russian President Vladimir Putin his 'friend.' Volker also weighs in on the leaked classified Pentagon memo about restricting defence ties with Canada.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: North American stocks soar, recovering half of last week's plunge after Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia's CEO
candidates.description: Nvidia led a tremendous rally on Wall Street on Monday following the surprise return of Jensen Huang as its CEO. Nvidia's stock finished just shy of its best day since 2000.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Quebecor CEO defends Telus bid, cites falling wireless prices and Canada's sovereignty
candidates.description: Quebecor CEO Pierre Karl Péladeau is defending his company's $31-billion bid to buy Telus amid concerns over competition in Canada's telecom sector, arguing the cost of wireless plans is dropping and non-Canadian companies are trying to expand.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Will Canadian workers refuse to handle Israeli goods? Why unions increasingly say they should
candidates.description: A movement to cut off Israeli goods is spreading across Canada's unions. The Canadian Labour Congress, which represents more than 3 million workers, passed a resolution last month declaring trade, services and relationships with Israel to be “hot cargo," emphasizing a call for workers to refuse to handle weapons and military equipment destined for Israel.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Nvidia reinstates CEO Jensen Huang after affair with alleged spy as Trump says 'I made the deal'
candidates.description: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal
candidates.description: Megaspeed has been accused of funneling AI chips to China after a former executive's affair with Jensen Huang became public.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
candidates.description: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says
candidates.description: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: UK sanctions top Myanmar military leaders after Rohingya genocide ruling
candidates.description: The UK is joined by several other nations in recognising an ICJ ruling that Myanmar carried out genocide.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Comedian impersonates Trump's dance moves, mocks trade talks at Canada press dinner
candidates.description: The impersonator, Canadian comedian Mark Critch, poked fun at the US president's search for a new press secretary and US-Canada trade talks.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: How Nvidia is reacting to Jensen Huang's return as CEO
candidates.description: BBC's Lily Jamali reports from Nvidia's headquarters, where she gauges the reaction to Huang's return after Trump says he brokered a deal.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Outrage after ICE arrest father and daughter at Seattle airport
candidates.description: ICE officers arrested two passengers, a father and daughter, as they were boarding a flight in Seattle on Saturday.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: First Lady Melania Trump welcomes this year's White House Christmas tree
candidates.description: The official 2026 White House Christmas tree is an 18-foot fir from Silent Night Evergreens, a farm in Endeavor, Wisconsin.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Dad who discovered daughter's murder on Facebook feels ignored by South African police
candidates.description: South African communities tell the BBC of measures they're taking to keep women safe after a wave of horrific killings.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'I want to destroy capitalism, not France': On the streets with the French ultra left
candidates.description: The BBC meets the far-left protesters French President Emmanuel Macron says are trying to bring down the Republic.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang
candidates.description: Days after resigning while mired in scandal of extra-marital affairs, Nvidia's Jensen Huang is making a remarkable return.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'
candidates.description: 21-year-old Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty to the Rockstar Games hack and others he carried out when he was a teenager.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate summit?
candidates.description: The COP31 climate summit in Turkey has formally come to an end after countries failed to agree a deal.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Mysterious Mercury gets a visitor - after spacecraft's eight-year epic voyage
candidates.description: The mission is set to give us our best ever view of Mercury - the closest planet to the Sun.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: New draft deal aims to avert collapse of talks at COP31 climate summit
candidates.description: The UN COP31 meeting in Turkey enters a second day of overtime as countries struggle to reach an agreement.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Record-breaking sightings of rare moth in Essex
candidates.description: There is now a self-sustaining population of the moth at a nature reserve in Essex, a charity says.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing
candidates.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure the alliance's eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Democrats win House by largest margin in 50 years. And, COP31 ends with no deal
candidates.description: Democrats have currently flipped 47 House seats and could flip 49 total. And, climate change talks at COP31 ran two days longer than expected, becoming the longest conference in the summit's history.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
candidates.description: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Ukraine war spilling into NATO territory
candidates.description: The war between Russia and Ukraine once again creeps onto European territory – from attacks on ships to missiles in Poland and fresh allegations of Russian operations inside Denmark.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Luxury development planned on land some Albanians say is theirs, not Jared Kushner's
candidates.description: A company working for President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner purchased 300 acres of Albanian land for more than $130 million in April. But Albanians in the area tell NPR this is not Kushner's land -- it's theirs.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Lebanese villagers return to wrecked homes as the Israeli army pulls back
candidates.description: In a pilot project in a village in southern Lebanon, Israeli forces have left and the Lebanese army moved it. But villagers who return find their houses wrecked.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Climate change talks fall apart in final hours over fossil fuels
candidates.description: Some 200 countries gathered in Antalya, Turkey, for COP31, the annual climate negotiations. Countries failed to reach an agreement over fossil fuels - the primary driver of global warming.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: They attended Trump's controversial meme coin dinner. It didn't go well
candidates.description: Trump held another meme coin dinner for top holders of his cryptocurrency — an event that has raised intense controversy. Here's an inside account from two guests who attended.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Some women in tech have concerns about Huang's return
candidates.description: Women who have advocated for DEI in tech say Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA as CEO sends a message that in Silicon Valley, all that matters is money. s
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Trump claims credit as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
candidates.description: President Trump endorsed the announcement, calling it essential for the success of the company and the economy. He added that the government does not see Huang's return as a national security risk.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Seniors embrace Tesla automated driving technology despite questions about safety
candidates.description: Older drivers are using Tesla's automated driving technology to stay on the road longer. But safety experts warn the company may be over-selling what its cars can do.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
candidates.description: America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated. One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: 'Medicare for all' is back on the drawing board. Does it stand a better chance this time?
candidates.description: Several newly elected Democratic U.S. senators campaigned on Medicare for All. Could this be the time it actually gets traction?
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Mushroom supplements promise health benefits. What does the science say?
candidates.description: Wellness influencers say mushroom supplements can help with your gut health, focus and immune system. Here is where research suggests there are some links.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Meet the young authors! A literacy program inspires kids in South Africa
candidates.description: South Africa is working to overcome a children's literacy crisis. In one Johannesburg township, a reading club is instilling a love of books in kids — and inspiring them to become authors.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Medicare looks a bit different in 2027, so don't miss open enrollment
candidates.description: Open enrollment for Medicare runs through Dec. 7, and there are a few different pitfalls people should watch out for this year. Your drug plan or Medicare Advantage plan could be changing a lot.
candidates.author: NPR
